title: No, Young Men Are Not Returning To Church. | Interesting Times with Ross Douthat
description:
Something surprising is happening to religious belief in America: It’s no longer trending downward. Are Americans becoming more religious? On this episode of “Interesting Times,” Ross sits down with the demographer and former pastor Ryan Burge to discuss the myths and realities of religious revival and debate whether the future belongs to ortho bros or Pagans.

01:30 - A new era of American religion
08:20 - The shifting gender balance in religion
13:41 - Class, education and social trust
18:54 - Tarot, astrology, and UFOs: Post-Christian spirituality
22:15 - The decline of the Seven Sisters
27:55 - Politics in the pews
39:54 - The religious and political America of 2050

Thoughts? Email us at interestingtimes@nytimes.com. 

Read the full transcript here: https://www.nytimes.com/2026/01/22/opinion/interesting-times-ryan-burge.html
